registerTableForm.tableStarting: Starting up, discovering files… this can take a while for large datasets
registerTableForm.tableStartingTimedOut: Still not ready after a long wait — the source's connector may have failed to start. Check the source's configuration or try again.
registerTableForm.importSetHint: Inserts go through the import set's transform map; updates and deletes are written to the table directly.
registerTableForm.importSetNone: None: write inserts to the table directly
registerTableForm.discoverHint: (infer columns from the live source at registration — for schemaless/NoSQL sources; no manual column selection needed)
registerTableForm.watermarkHintOptional: Used for polling when triggers are unavailable.
registerTableForm.errorRequiredFields: Source, schema, and table name are required.
registerTableForm.errorCacheTtlRequired: Set a Cache TTL: this table will be a replica, and its source states none.
registerTableForm.cacheTtlHint: This table will be a replica, refreshed on this clock. Its source states no Cache TTL, so the table states its own.
registerTableForm.errorNoColumnsSelected: At least one column must be selected.
registerTableForm.errorUntypedColumns: Every column needs a data type. Assign one for: {{columns}}
registerTableForm.dqResultsTableHint: (derived from the scanned table; one row per check per scan, every scan kept)
registerTableForm.dqResultsTablePlaceholder: Pick the table to scan above
registerTableForm.dqDescription: Quality scan results for {{table}} — one row per check per scan, with outcome, metric value and threshold
registerTableForm.errorDqContract: Pick the table to scan in the Data Quality panel.
registerTableForm.errorDqVisibleTo: Results must be visible to at least one role.
registerTableForm.dqScanIntervalHint: Each scan adds its results to the table; earlier scans are kept.
registerTableForm.errorDqScanInterval: Set how often the table is scanned, in seconds.
registerTableForm.neo4jCypherHint: project scalar values only (RETURN n.prop AS col)
registerTableForm.neo4jCypherPlaceholder: MATCH (a:Adopter) RETURN a.adopter_id AS adopter_id, a.name AS name
registerTableForm.neo4jPreviewNoRows: The query returned no rows; columns cannot be inferred. Add a row to the graph or change the query.
registerTableForm.errorNeo4jCypher: Enter the Cypher that produces the table's rows.
registerTableForm.errorNeo4jPreviewFirst: Preview the Cypher first so the columns and their types are known.
registerTableForm.sparqlQueryHint: a SELECT whose variables become the columns (every binding is text)
registerTableForm.nlSearchPlaceholder: e.g. customer invoicing and payment tables
registerTableForm.nlSearchNone: No table in this schema matches that description.
registerTableForm.nlSearchColumnsLoading: Table names were searched in full. Column names in this schema are still loading, so a table that matches only by a column may be missing; this search repeats until they are loaded.
registerTableForm.nlSearchColumnsUnavailable: Table names were searched in full. Column names in this schema could not be loaded, so only table names and descriptions were searched.
registerTableForm.fileGlobLabel: File glob (one table over many files)
registerTableForm.fileGlobHint: optional — leave blank for a single file
registerTableForm.sourceFileColumnHint: optional — a column holding each row's file path
registerTableForm.profilerNoMembers: No table has joined this profiler
registerTableForm.profilerRowRulesNone: Every reader sees every described column.
registerTableForm.profilerRowRuleFailed: The table was registered, but the row rule for {{role}} was not saved: {{message}}
registerTableForm.scopeHelp: domain: served to roles that reach this table's domain. public: also to roles outside it. restricted: only to the roles named in Visible to.
registerTableForm.shortColumns: Registered with the types discovered ({{count}}): {{names}}. Hiding, keys and test data are set in the editor that opens next.
registerTableForm.shortUntyped: No type was found for these columns. Choose one for each:
registerTableForm.pipelineQueryHint: {"inputCollection": …, "pipeline": […]} -- an argument is a whole value "{{name}}"
registerTableForm.pipelineArgumentsHelp: Each argument is a parameter of the table, given on every read: a WHERE condition on its column in SQL, an argument in GraphQL. Its value is bound into the pipeline as a value of its type. A sample value is used for the preview only.
registerTableForm.cosmosQueryHint: {"container": …, "query": "SELECT … @name"} -- each @name is an argument, sent beside the query
registerTableForm.cosmosQueryPlaceholder: {"container": "products", "query": "SELECT TOP 10 c.id, c.name, VectorDistance(c.embedding, @query_vector) AS score FROM c ORDER BY VectorDistance(c.embedding, @query_vector)"}
registerTableForm.esSearchHint: {"index": …, "query": {…}, "aggs": {…}} -- an argument is a whole value "{{name}}"; aggregations answer a row per bucket
registerTableForm.qdrantSearchHint: {"collection": …, "query": "@query_vector", "filter": {…}, "limit": …} -- each "@name" is an argument, placed into the search as a value. Name a registered embedding model ("model") to search by text.
